summary: Sonoco Products Company filed a Form 8-K reporting entry into a First Amendment to its August 7, 2023 Credit Agreement with Farm Credit System lenders and CoBank as administrative agent, effective September 25, 2026. The amendment creates a $400 million Tranche A term loan maturing December 31, 2029, and a $400 million Tranche B delayed-draw term loan maturing December 31, 2031. Sonoco drew $500 million at closing to refinance an existing $500 million syndicated term loan due August 2028, with $300 million remaining available in up to three draws over twelve months. This is a routine credit-facility refinancing, not a special situation; no equity terms, board recommendation, or advisor applies. Watch ratings-linked pricing and leverage.
